intro: Solomon Islands has volcanic islands, coral atolls and one of the largest saltwater lagoons in the world.

chapters.title: Islands and lagoons
text: Guadalcanal is the largest island. Marovo Lagoon is one of the world's largest saltwater lagoons. East Rennell, a raised coral atoll, is a World Heritage site.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The islands are hot and wet, and rising seas threaten low islands.
